def execution_waves(steps):
    items = list(steps)
    ids = [item["id"] for item in items]
    if any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value for value in ids) or len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
        raise ValueError("invalid step id")
    known = set(ids)
    if any(set(item["needs"]) - known for item in items):
        raise ValueError("missing prerequisite")
    remaining = set(ids)
    waves = []
    while remaining:
        wave = [item["id"] for item in items if item["id"] in remaining and not (set(item["needs"]) & remaining)]
        if not wave:
            raise ValueError("dependency cycle")
        waves.append(wave)
        remaining.difference_update(wave)
    return waves

def due_notification_ids(records, now):
    from datetime import datetime
    parse = lambda value: datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    instant = parse(now)
    return [record["id"] for record in records if parse(record["scheduled_at"]) <= instant]

def due_notification_ids(records, now):
    from datetime import datetime
    parse = lambda value: datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    cutoff = parse(now)
    return [record["id"] for record in records if parse(record["scheduled_at"]) < cutoff]

def running_balances(opening, entries):
    current = _money(opening)
    balances = []
    applied_ids = set()
    for row in entries:
        identifier = row.get("id")
        kind = row["kind"]
        if kind not in {"credit", "debit"}:
            raise ValueError("unsupported entry kind")
        duplicate = isinstance(identifier, str) and bool(identifier) and identifier in applied_ids
        if not duplicate:
            value = _money(row["amount"])
            current = current + value if kind == "credit" else current - value
        if isinstance(identifier, str) and identifier:
            applied_ids.add(identifier)
        balances.append(f"{current:.2f}")
    return balances

def build_deliveries(event, subscriptions, templates):
    deliveries = []
    emitted = set()
    for row in subscriptions:
        template = templates.get(f"{event['type']}:{row['channel']}")
        identity = row["channel"], row["destination"]
        if row["event"] != event["type"] or not row["enabled"] or template is None or identity in emitted:
            continue
        emitted.add(identity)
        deliveries.append(dict(channel=row["channel"], destination=row["destination"], body=template.format_map(event["data"])))
    return deliveries

def availability_report(products, warehouse_rows):
    rows = list(warehouse_rows)
    report = []
    for product in products:
        match = canonical_sku(product["sku"])
        available = sum(int(row["quantity"]) for row in rows if canonical_sku(row["sku"]) == match)
        report.append(dict(sku=product["sku"], name=product["name"], available=available))
    return report

def merge_context(base, overlay):
    import copy
    result = copy.deepcopy(base)
    result.update(copy.deepcopy(overlay))
    return result
